description: This file implements database driver classes for SQLite using Web Workers and shared services, specifically for the Notesnook project. It manages multi-tab and single-tab SQLite connections, including initialization, transaction control, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerMultipleTabDriver
classes.description: Driver class managing SQLite connections across multiple browser tabs using shared worker services.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerSingleTabDriver
classes.description: Driver class managing a single SQLite connection within one browser tab using a dedicated Web Worker.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerConnection
classes.description: Represents a database connection that executes queries via a Web Worker or remote interface, with mutex-based sequential execution control.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting up shared services or Web Workers, and prepares the database connection.

methods.name: acquireConnection
methods.description: Acquires and returns the database connection, ensuring proper initialization and mutex control.

methods.name: rollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.

methods.name: releaseConnection
methods.description: Releases the mutex lock on the database connection.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the driver, closing connections or workers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the database or associated resources.

methods.name: #initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks if needed, such as calling user-defined init functions.
